Method of Attack: Malicious email attachments with macros that install malware
Enabling macros in malicious Word documents to install ransomware or banking trojans
Impacted Systems: Windows computers of organizations in Germany, Italy, and the United States
Attack Vector: Malicious email attachments (Word documents) with macros
Indicators of Compromise: Emails impersonating United States Postal Service, German Federal Ministry of Finance (Bundeszentralamt fur Steuern), Italian Revenue Agency (Agenzia delle Entrate)
Lookalike domains and stolen branding of government agencies
